about.title: Sourcing shouldn't be an act of faith.
body: SourcingPick exists because international procurement, in 2026, is still a chain of patience, WhatsApp threads, and wire transfers in the dark. Buyers pay upfront to suppliers they've never met. Factories accept specs they haven't had time to qualify. The opaque middleman pockets the difference.

We're building the opposite: a platform where every request is qualified by a human, every quote is compared on the same scoring grid, and every payment stays in escrow until confirmed delivery. The platform's margin is transparent, not buried in the price.
We're based in France but our factory network covers Europe, the Maghreb, Asia, Africa, and the Americas. Language is not a barrier — neither is time zone.

escrow.body: Buyer funds stay blocked at our payment provider until conforming delivery is confirmed. This is non-negotiable.

sections.heading: Acceptance of terms
body: By accessing SourcingPick or creating an account, you agree to be bound by these terms of service. If you do not accept these terms, you must not use the service.

sections.heading: Description of the service
body: SourcingPick is a SaaS platform that connects buyers ("Clients") with manufacturers ("Factories") through three main services: on-demand sourcing, a marketplace of pre-negotiated products, and a certification programme.
SourcingPick acts as a trusted third party and operates a funds-escrow mechanism via a licensed payment provider.

sections.heading: Accounts and verification
body: Account creation is free. Each organisation must provide accurate, up-to-date information and complete a verification (KYC) procedure before transacting.
You are responsible for the confidentiality of your credentials. Any activity carried out from your account is presumed to be yours.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
body: You may not use SourcingPick for illegal or fraudulent activities, or activities contrary to French and European regulations on international trade, labour law, or intellectual property.
Any circumvention of the escrow mechanism, the certification programme, or our verification tools is strictly prohibited.

sections.heading: Payments, commissions, and escrow
body: Funds paid by Clients are collected by our payment provider and held in escrow until the buyer confirms conforming receipt of the goods.
SourcingPick takes a commission on each transaction. The rate depends on the subscribed plan and is disclosed at quote time.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
body: All elements of the platform (software, design, trademarks, editorial content) are the exclusive property of SourcingPick or its licensors.
You retain all rights in the content you publish (specifications, photos, documents) and grant SourcingPick a limited licence to use it for operating the service.

sections.heading: Warranties and limitation of liability
body: SourcingPick takes all reasonable steps to vet its partner factories but cannot guarantee absolute conformity of manufactured products. The escrow mechanism is designed precisely to protect the buyer in case of non-conformity.
Our liability is limited, to the extent permitted by law, to the amount actually received in respect of the affected transaction.

sections.heading: Termination
body: You may terminate your account at any time from your settings. SourcingPick may suspend or terminate an account in case of breach of these terms, after notice.

sections.heading: Changes to the terms
body: We may modify these terms to reflect changes in the service or in regulations. Any material change will be notified to you by email at least 30 days before it takes effect.

sections.heading: Governing law and jurisdiction
body: These terms are governed by French law. Any dispute shall fall within the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the Paris Court of Appeal, subject to mandatory legal provisions to the contrary.

sections.heading: Contact
body: For any question about these terms: legal@sourcingpick.com.

sections.heading: Data controller
body: SourcingPick SAS, headquartered in France, is the controller of personal data collected via the platform. To exercise your rights or contact our Data Protection Officer: dpo@sourcingpick.com.

sections.heading: Data we collect
body: Account data: first name, last name, email, phone, preferred language, role, and parent organisation.
Organisation data: legal name, registration number, VAT number, address, bank details, KYC documents.
Usage data: login history, requests created, quotes received, orders, messages exchanged.

sections.heading: Purposes and legal bases
body: Contract performance: delivery of the sourcing service, processing of orders and payments.
Legal obligations: KYC compliance, anti-money-laundering, invoicing, accounting retention.
Legitimate interest: platform security, fraud prevention, service improvement.
Consent: audience measurement, marketing communications (where you explicitly opt in).

sections.heading: Data sharing
body: We share certain data with technical service providers under contract (hosting, email, payments, KYC) acting as processors under GDPR.
We never sell your data. We may be required to disclose it to competent authorities under legal obligation.

sections.heading: Retention periods
body: Account data: kept while your account is active, then archived for 3 years after the last transaction.
KYC documents: kept for 5 years after the end of the business relationship, per AML-CFT obligations.
Invoicing data: kept for 10 years, per the French Commercial Code.

sections.heading: Your rights (GDPR)
body: You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection regarding your personal data. You can exercise these from your settings or by writing to dpo@sourcingpick.com.
In case of disagreement, you may lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).

sections.heading: International transfers
body: Our primary infrastructure is hosted in the European Union. When processing an order involves partners outside the EU, we apply the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses to govern the transfers.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: Our use of cookies is detailed in our dedicated cookies policy.

sections.heading: Security
body: Sensitive data (passwords, IBANs, KYC documents) are encrypted at rest. Access is restricted on a need-to-know basis and logged. Two-factor authentication is mandatory for Admin accounts.

sections.heading: Contact
body: Data Protection Officer: dpo@sourcingpick.com.

sections.heading: What is a cookie?
body: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device when you visit a website. It lets the site remember certain information (language, login session, consent choice) between visits.

sections.heading: Strictly necessary cookies
body: These cookies are essential to the platform's operation and do not require your prior consent.
sp_locale (1 year) — remembers your preferred language.
sp_consent (1 year) — records your choice regarding non-essential cookies.
next-auth.session-token (session) — keeps you signed in while authenticated.
next-auth.csrf-token (session) — protects authentication forms against CSRF attacks.

sections.heading: Non-essential cookies
body: In the current version, SourcingPick does not set any non-essential cookies. If we introduce analytics or marketing tools in the future, they will only be set after your explicit consent via the dedicated banner.

sections.heading: Managing your choices
body: You can change your choice at any time by deleting the sp_consent cookie from your browser settings, then reloading the page: the consent banner will reappear.
You can also block or delete all cookies via your browser settings. Note that this may affect certain features of the service (notably authentication).

sections.heading: Contact
body: For any question about our use of cookies: dpo@sourcingpick.com.
